recipes.title: Air Fryer Breaded Chicken Breast

ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 8 ounces each, cut into 1/2 inch dices)
1/4 plus 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt ( and black pepper, to taste)

4 (12 oz total) sweet Italian chicken sausage (cut in 1 inch pieces )
1 cup red onion (sliced ¼ inch thick (from 1 small onion))

ingredients: 3 medium  sweet potatoes (8 ounces each, peeled)
3 large  shallots (peeled and halved (or 1 small red onion, cut into wedges))
recipes.description: This easy sheet pan Spatchcock Chicken with Sweet Potatoes is the ultimate one-pan fall dinner.
